[USER] User requested to code a Node.js trading bot for Uniswap, specifically a Sniping Bot.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a basic outline for creating a Uniswap trading bot using Node.js.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended installing the `uniswap-v2-sdk` package for interacting with the Uniswap API.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided the command: `npm install uniswap-v2-sdk` for installation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested importing dependencies and initializing the Uniswap instance with the following code:  
```
const { UniswapV2Factory } = require("uniswap-v2-sdk");
const { ethers } = require("ethers");

// Initialize the Uniswap instance
const uniswap = new UniswapV2Factory(
  ethers.getDefaultProvider("rinkeby") // or mainnet, etc.
);
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant instructed to use the `uniswap.getPair()` method to get the Uniswap pair for the desired token.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided the code snippet for getting the token address:  
```
const tokenAddress = "0x..."; // Address of the token

// Get the Uniswap pair for the token
const pair = await uniswap.getPair(tokenAddress);
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned using the `pair.getReserves()` method to get the current token reserves for the Uniswap pair.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided the code snippet for getting reserves:  
```
const [reserve0, reserve1] = await pair.getReserves();
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained using the `pair.swap()` method to execute a trade on the Uniswap pair.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided the code snippet for executing a trade:  
```
const amount = 1; // Amount of tokens to buy/sell

// Execute the trade
const {
  outputAmount,
  transactionHash,
  gasPrice,
  gasUsed,
} = await pair.swap(amount);
```
